_comment: us-east-1 pricing snapshot. All values VERIFIED against the official AWS pricing pages on 2026-08-17 (verified_date) and marked verify:false. DynamoDB on-demand corrected to the post-2024 rates (WRU 0.625/M, RRU 0.125/M). Re-confirm before final publication as prices can change.

write_request_unit_per_million.unit: USD per 1,000,000 write request units (on-demand, post-2024 rate)

read_request_unit_per_million.unit: USD per 1,000,000 read request units (on-demand, post-2024 rate)

publish_per_million.unit: USD per 1,000,000 standard-topic requests (each 64KB chunk = 1 request); first 1M/month free
